name: Ares Management Corporation
blurb: Ares Management Corporation is a global alternative asset manager operating through Direct Lending, Private Equity, and other segments. It provides financing solutions to small-to-medium sized companies and specializes in growth capital, middle market, mezzanine, distressed, and growth buyouts across sectors such as healthcare, services, energy, industrials, and consumer. The firm primarily invests in North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, taking majority, minority, and shared-control positions. As of May 2026, Ares Management has a market capitalization of approximately $40.6 billion and manages over $5.9 billion in revenue.
recent: In the past 30 days, Ares Management stock experienced a decline, with a 14.9% drop in market cap and a 52-week range of $95.80 to $195.26. The company reported earnings on May 1, 2026, with net income up 42.2% year-over-year to $564.1 million and EPS of $2.10, a 19.6% increase. Analysts maintain a Buy rating with a price target of $166.25, suggesting a 35% upside from the current price of $123.15.
